verdict.rationale: DPMA's online services (DEPATISnet search, DPMAregister, and the DPMAdirektWeb and DPMAdirektPro filing tools) could plausibly offer AI-assisted insights or suggestions, so the axis applies. None of the evidence mentions AI-generated insights, suggestions or analysis of user data. The documented features are search, register lookup and electronic filing only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
